Mark the student's response to a question from Riverview Task 1 2024 (a Riverview Year 12 Business Studies assessment, Operations topic) strictly against the official marking criteria, exactly as an HSC marker would: award marks only for what is actually written, do not be generous, and quote the criteria row the response fits. Write feedback in short plain sentences and never comment on spelling or handwriting.

Question 12(a) [2 marks]: Outline an impact of globalisation on this business.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Chris Cringle Decorations are a large Sydney based seller of artificial Christmas trees and decorations. They currently source stock from a Chinese manufacturer and storage costs have doubled within the last 6 months.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 2):
2 marks: Sketches in general terms the impact of globalisation on CCD
1 marks: May reference an impact of globalisation on CCD

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Globalisation refers to the removal of trade barriers and the ever closer integration of world economies. CCD source products from China; by doing so they decrease costs in comparison to buying from an Australian provider, because compliance, employment and manufacturing costs are more expensive in Australia.

ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
Globalisation is the increasing integration between national economies and the transfer of capital, labour, intellectual capital, ideas, finance and technology. It presents opportunities (lower costs, new markets) or threats for businesses that do not adapt. Businesses can leverage the competitive advantage of each region (global sourcing). Enabled by reduced transport costs (container shipping). Must be linked to CCD.

TEACHER MARKER COMMENTS:
Students suggested that the increase in storage cost is due to globalisation. This is untrue: CCD control the orders from China and are over-ordering, which is a failure of the business to plan. Students did not define the key term in a number of cases, and some incorrectly inferred information not in the scenario.
